description.en: dsh-sd-bridge-guard插件已发布，可以帮你完善提示词，提高图片质量，并做到dsh无限制生图
面向 AI 编码助手的源码知识生产工具包：提取业务规则，生成可追溯的机器人问答知识 | An agent toolkit for evidence-backed knowledge from source code.
DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin: process-discipline system-prompt section + deterministic progress nudge for silent tool steps
description.zh: 让 AI 干活时别闷头狂跑工具，主动汇报进度，过程更透明可控。

description.en: Pluggable design canvas inside DSH — standalone Excalidraw board, session image tools (edit, erase, background removal, OCR, vectorize, PSD/text rebuild), project asset library, and a Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ canvas bridge.
description.zh: DSH 内的可插拔设计画布——独立 Excalidraw 画布、会话图片工具（修图、擦除、去背景、OCR、转矢量、PSD/文字重建）、项目素材库，以及 Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ 画布桥接。

description.en: 把 Qoder 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：用 PAT 调用与 Qoder CLI 同源的模型服务，支持国内版 / 国际版双区域、模型开关、上下文窗口与每日签到，并提供只读的额度概览。
description.zh: 粘贴 PAT 就能在 DSH 里直接用 Qoder 模型，支持双区域、模型开关和额度查看。

description.en: SapBuddy-dsh
description.zh: SapBuddy 的 DSH 版：41 个 SAP 工具、技能集、写门禁。

description.en: Weixin iLink channel for DeepSeek Harness — text, media, persona modes, settings page (QR login, allowlist), companion pacing and proactive messages.
星主制作的大肥鱼世界，希望大家喜欢！
Bring text-to-video and image-to-video generation to DeepSeek Harness — DashScope Wanx, Volcengine/Doubao Seedance, Google Veo, OpenAI Sora & compatible relays.
ARIS research-workflow skills as a DeepSeek Harness bundle: 82 skills plus cross-model adversarial review through Codex.
Bluxe手绘工坊 · 生图工作台（图文 / 摄影）：DSH 侧栏图像生成工作台，默认使用内置本地账号池，亦支持任意 OpenAI 兼容接口（Base URL / API Key / 模型）；可自定义工作台名称与图片存储目录。
Tobs — Team of bots with persistent memory, delegation and messaging.
「云接力」：把本地 DSH 会话一键迁到云端 DSH 继续执行，笔记本合盖/关机不中断；回本地重开自动同步云端结果（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
在 DSH 里搜索并播放哔哩哔哩音频：侧边栏「音乐」面板 + 顶部常驻迷你播放条（电台续播 / 可拖拽吸附成悬浮球 / 歌单 / 点赞踩收藏 / 全局热键 / 播放进度记忆）
Modern UI browser extension for the unmodified official DSH release
description.zh: 给未改动的官方 DSH 换一套网页界面：思考过程分组折叠、对话轮次时间轴与可调阅读宽度、工具调用卡片、模型与思考强度选择面板、子智能体编队视图、回答里可选的图表与流程图组件、明暗主题和手机布局。从 npm 安装，卸载即恢复官方界面。可选的 jev_presentation_advice 工具只有在你保存 TypeSafe 密钥后才会启用，它会把最近最多四条用户消息和一份简短的回答提纲发送到 api.typesafe.ai。

description.en: AI 驱动的法律行业案件管理与 Agent 工具：诉讼案件 / 非诉项目 / 任务中心 / 期限引擎 / 技能与 MCP，Agent 预设直接办案，运行于 DeepSeek Harness。

A DSH sidebar plugin that shows AnySearch references as cards, with the search query, source snippets and highlighted keywords in the right sidebar.一个 DSH 侧边栏插件，把 AnySearch 的搜索结果以卡片形式展示在右侧侧边栏中，包括搜索词、来源摘要和关键词高亮。
适用于DeepSeek Harness Web GUI的GirlsBangCry 皮肤
DeepSeek Harness native plugin: Settings UI for the Roblox Studio MCP bridge - list connected Studio instances, pick the active one, and expose the selection to agents as runtime context.
Agent Community UI — Bot list, room list, chat panel, run status
Upsello: a Shopify store-operations agent for DeepSeek Harness - a DSH bundle plugin with store tools and a sidebar entry

dsh-voice-say：把一句话合成语音（本机 Breeze TTS 2，离线免费）。上传一段音频就是嗓子——逐字转写可以不用手打，插件用本地 faster-whisper 自动听写（也可自己指定 python / 装识别环境）；主参数两个——instructions（自然语言写「怎么说话」）与 guidanceScale；18 个风格可叠加；音色可存库、可指定 QQ 桥接用哪个嗓子（设了就只认它，文件丢了直接报错不退回默认）。合成前「读音导演」按人设、当下情绪与对话情节重排标点（只动标点不改字）。Q
Quota pill for DeepSeek Harness: remaining quota for every LLM subscription you have, in one collapsible pill
description.zh: 在输入框旁用一个小胶囊实时显示各 LLM 订阅还剩多少额度，一眼看清用量。

description.en: Message box for DeepSeek Harness: finished-conversation and pending-approval notifications with jump-to-conversation and inline approval.
外贸/制造数据工作台：标准、HS、贸易术语、单证一次查完，返回可引用结果。
description.zh: mj7.cn 只读工具：检索标准、产品与材料，另有 HS 编码联想、Incoterms、贸易单证与人民币汇率，共 6 个工具。仅网络访问，不写本地。

description.en: Standalone DSH plugin for PPT authoring, template selection, validation and editable PPTX export
DeepSeek web chat → DeepSeek Harness sessions (Edge extension + importer CLI + DSH plugin)
description.zh: 把配套 Edge 扩展（需在 Edge 里“加载已解压的扩展”）从 chat.deepseek.com 抓取并导出的对话重建为 DeepSeek Harness 新会话；思考存为旁挂 thinking.md，被截断、分叉或超长的对话另存完整原文 transcript.md。

description.en: Cortex workbench for DeepSeek Harness: the original Cortex UI (vulnerabilities, assets, internal operations, Memory Nebula, snapshots, retest, Web Fuzzer, mini-program reversing) as a native DSH panel, plus 22 native agent tools so DSH conversations use t
DSH LEWIS ENCHANTMENT · 附魔台｜开机动画：铺满当前窗口的完整开场、自定义视频与封面、启动检查更新和磨砂提示。

Delegate coding tasks from DeepSeek Harness to the Google Antigravity desktop agent, and watch every turn live in a War Room dashboard: a five-stage lifecycle stepper, streaming tool-call timeline with clean/hanging/escape/destructive verdicts, dual-windo
DeepSeek Harness plugin: deterministic Chinese-recipe browser RPA via webclaw-lite
description.zh: 用中文自然语言配方驱动浏览器自动操作，把重复网页流程变成可复用的确定性脚本。

description.en: Back up and restore dsh-mnemon memory and skill components (memory spaces, project documents, runtime memory, skill files, skill data) to S3-compatible storage or WebDAV.
description.zh: 给 dsh-mnemon 做备份与恢复：它的三类记忆组件（记忆空间、项目档案、运行时记忆）可任选，打包到 S3 兼容存储或 WebDAV，之后可浏览备份列表并只恢复选中的部分。SQLite 库经 node:sqlite 的 backup() 在线复制，写入方同时写也不会撕开副本；每个文件带 SHA-256，上传前校验一次、恢复前再校验一次；恢复默认只做预览，写回数据库前会先删掉残留的 -wal/-shm。备份文件名是 mnemon-sync-<设备名>-<时间戳>.zip，多台机器备份到同一目录也能分辨来源。定时器只有一个，间隔从每小时到每周；凭据存在 DSH profile 之外的 0600 文件里；除 Node 外没有其他依赖。

description.en: Sync your DeepSeek Harness (DSH) configuration between machines over a private git or WebDAV channel: settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agent presets and provider credentials. DSH 配置远程同步插件（私有通道，明文自用）。
Foxy's Weibo transport for DeepSeek Harness: follow users, read posts, comment, reply, and remember events.
ArcVista 观界 —— DSH 内的架构观测台：本地项目、Git 克隆或批量 Git 导入，架构图、安全守护、知识图谱、复杂度与快照对比
description.zh: 接入 Git 仓库就能自动生成架构图、安全清单和业务知识图谱，还能对比分支间的架构漂移与风险。

description.en: Workspace- and session-scoped rules for DeepSeek Harness · 按工作区/会话分层维护守则，会话里逐层勾选带入，默认关闭
被 dsh-memory-shield 遮蔽的会话的隔离记忆包：五轨（memory/user/project/key/daily）独立数据目录，与 dsh-memory-evolve 完全隔离。装完即已生效——默认只提供管理页，不接管任何会话；在目标 preset 里设 memoryEnabled: true 才启用。
Standalone personal assistant DSH plugin with multi-Bot profiles and an explicit Cloud Computer Broker boundary.
橙客 OranLeads：社媒评论区 AI 获客工作台（DSH 插件）
A Codex delegation tool for DeepSeek Harness that can carry a model and a reasoning effort per call.
description.zh: 让 Codex 子代理每次调用都能单独指定模型和推理强度，灵活调度更省心。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Deepseek Budget.
Scoped, bounded, approval-gated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents.
Agent Community core service — Bot management, rooms, messaging, and run scheduling
Browse dashboards built from your local data and filter them by tag; create, edit and tag them in the conversation.
GPT image generation and editing for DeepSeek Harness: image_generate and image_edit tools, plus an in-app settings page with connection test, model picker, and gallery.

Delete sessions of a DeepSeek Harness profile from the UI: session-row menu item with a confirm dialog; the host endpoint deletes the log, projection cache and workspace accounting, cascading through the whole subagent tree. Optionally exposes session_lis
DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 风格模型弹窗，七档界面映射原生四档及可交互星尘 / Codex-style DSH model and effort menus
An Overview tab for DeepSeek Harness: folds a session into progress, artifacts, and references.
抖音自动陪伴插件 for DeepSeek Harness：私信/评论自动回复、刷流挑视频、人格与长期记忆、语音、观看日报。Proprietary.
Agent-safe EVM wallet for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): encrypted local keys, signing policy and spending limits, pre-signing security checks, x402 payments
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体配一个安全的 EVM 钱包，本地加密私钥、限额签名、付款前先做安全检查，还能直接走 x402 支付。

description.en: Multi-model task dispatch and Web task board for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让旗舰模型专注拆解、审查和整合，把具体实现分派给其他模型，还带一个网页任务看板。

description.en: Suggested next-step prompts under every finished agent turn in the DeepSeek Harness chat — one click sends the followup.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后自动给出下一步提示词，点一下就能直接发送，省去手动输入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skill bundle for HOI4 1.19.3 modding: focus trees, tech-tree UI, tank designer, 3D tank models, DDS icons, scripted GUI/topbar, CJK fonts, 14 bundled Python tools, a 23-workshop-mod survey and an agent-teams playbook. No game assets.
Companion-AI hot/cold memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto dialogue archive, graduated cooling, cue-gated recall, 1600-token memory snapshot. ｜ 陪伴 AI 冷热分层记忆：全自动归档 + 渐进冷存 + 线索召回。
description.zh: 给陪伴 AI 加上冷热分层记忆，自动归档对话、渐进冷存、按线索召回，省 token 不忘事。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that registers the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server as mcp__rea__* tools — third-party adapter
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向工程 MCP 服务器接进 DSH，让你直接调用工具拆解分析任意目标。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH where an LLM decides what to keep: turns pool while the session is idle, then the main chat model distills them into one-line entries in a single batched call; vector dedup runs before insert, so near-duplicates and saturated topics are dropped; recall uses hybrid vector plus FTS5 search over tiered hot, warm and cold storage; ships remember, recall, forget and prune tools. Zero dependencies, Node only.
description.zh: DSH 长期记忆插件，由 LLM 裁决什么值得记：会话空闲后把攒下的轮次一次性交给主对话模型提炼成一句话条目；入库前先做向量判重，近重复与同话题超量的条目不再进库；检索走向量 + FTS5 混合召回，热/温/冷分层存储；附记/回忆/忘/清理四个显式工具。零依赖，纯 Node。

description.en: Derives the index from your Markdown memory files on every turn instead of keeping a hand-written index table, so renames, splits and deletions never leave a stale entry. Retrieval ranks by library tags, section tags, title tokens and body text, then injects the matching line ranges rather than whole files. Writing is model-proposed and user-confirmed through a sticky note; entries are appended after the target section's format is detected. Ships a structure panel showing each library and section with line ranges and token estimates, a starter template for an empty memory directory, and optional appearance controls.
description.zh: 每轮从你的 Markdown 记忆文件现场派生索引，不维护手写索引表，所以改名、拆库、删库都不会留下指向虚空的旧条目。检索按库标签、章节标签、标题词与正文多维排序，注入命中的行号区间而不是整篇文件。写入由模型提议、你在便利贴上确认，落盘前先探测目标章节的格式再追加。自带结构面板（每个库与章节的行号区间和 token 估算）、空记忆目录的一键起手模板，以及可选的外观调整。

description.en: Skill that transcribes local audio files into a timestamped transcript and an interactive two-column minutes page, with optional speaker separation. Transcription uses mlx-whisper in a Python 3.11 environment you set up yourself (the first run may download models); the renderer uses only the system python3. Given a public short-video share link, it can also drive a real browser through ego-browser and fetch the audio track with curl and ffmpeg, none of which ship with the package.
description.zh: 把本地录音转成带时间戳的文字稿和双栏交互式纪要的技能，可选说话人分离。转写使用你自备的 Python 3.11 环境里的 mlx-whisper（首次运行可能下载模型），渲染只用系统 python3。给一条公开短视频分享链接时，还能通过 ego-browser 驱动真实浏览器、用 curl 与 ffmpeg 取音轨；这三者都不随包提供。

description.en: A patched build of ranxianglei/billion-context (MIT) with the author's model-request accelerator folded in: verified snapshot reuse, parent-session inheritance for forks, outbound request-body compression, and image folding after the first send.
description.zh: ranxianglei/billion-context（MIT）的补丁构建，并内置作者的模型请求加速器：快照复用校验、fork 继承父会话、出站请求体压缩、图片看过一次即折叠。

description.en: A session workspace for DeepSeek Harness modeled on the Claude app, with forked sessions nested in one tree, up to four sessions on one screen, and a right rail per pane.
description.zh: 参照 Claude 应用会话界面的 DSH 工作区：fork 会话收进一棵树，一屏最多四个会话并排，每屏带自己的右栏。

description.en: Extract CSS themes from URLs, DOCX or PDF; generate, validate and export ColaMD contract themes, and export Markdown to standalone HTML or PDF.
description.zh: 从 URL、DOCX 或 PDF 提取 CSS 主题，生成并校验 ColaMD 契约主题，以及将 Markdown 导出为独立 HTML 或 PDF。

description.en: Adds an Explain this action button under the permission approval card that asks the session model for a plain-language description of the pending operation — what it does, which files it touches, whether it modifies or deletes anything, and the privacy risk — plus a risk level and an allow or reject recommendation. Explanations are generated in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 在权限审批卡片下面加一个「解释这条操作」按钮：调用当前会话模型，把待批准的操作翻成大白话——做什么、碰哪些文件、会不会改动或删除、有没有隐私风险——再给出风险等级和允许或拒绝的建议。解释以简体中文生成。

description.en: Client-side image downscaler for DeepSeek Harness: intercepts paste and drag-drop images over 1999px in memory via HTML Canvas and raises legacy attachment maxImageDimension up to 4096 when writable.
description.zh: DSH 图片上传前客户端等比压缩插件：拦截剪贴板粘贴与拖拽上传的图像，在内存中用 Canvas 将最长边超过 1999px 的图片等比缩放后再投递，并在未冻结的旧宿主上尝试放宽 maxImageDimension 至 4096。

description.en: Runtime policy guards that block repeated failing tool calls, oversized shell commands and network commands chained with local ones, composite batch tools (read_batch/edit_batch), a SYSTEM.md mode that replaces the official system-prompt sections with your own file, soft convergence notices, and turn telemetry for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的运行时策略防护（拦截重复失败的工具调用、超长 shell 命令、与本地命令串联的网络命令）、复合批处理工具（read_batch/edit_batch）、用你自己的 SYSTEM.md 替换官方系统提示词各段的模式、软收敛提醒和回合遥测。

description.en: Adds Blue Archive style click and touch effects plus a cursor trail to the DSH Web GUI, with theme color, scale, opacity, glow, speed and on/off switches on a Click FX page in Settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加蔚蓝档案风格的点击/触摸特效与鼠标拖尾，并在设置的 Click FX 页提供主题色、大小、不透明度、辉光、速度与开关。

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock: DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, MiniMax and Alibaba Cloud Token Plan, with peak/off-peak and night-discount countdowns.
description.zh: 输入框下方按供应商显示账户余额的芯片：支持 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、智谱/GLM、MiniMax 和阿里云 Token Plan，并带高峰/低谷与夜间折扣倒计时。

description.en: Self-managed persistent browser for DSH automation — launches its own Chrome/Edge profile, navigates, switches tabs, snapshots with semantic refs, acts by ref, evaluates JS, screenshots, and uploads files. Does not bypass CAPTCHAs by design.
description.zh: 自带浏览器的自动化插件：起自己的 Chrome/Edge 持久 profile，导航、切标签、语义快照、按 ref 操作、执行 JS、截图、塞文件。按设计不绕过验证码。

description.en: Daily auto check-in for MiniMax Code, WPS Lingxi, Baidu DuMate, AStudio, Qoder, Trae, Doubao, Huawei CodeArts and Tencent WorkBuddy: reads each app's own local credentials so nothing has to be pasted, supports multiple accounts per service, and lets you add any other site yourself by importing a JSON definition the agent wrote for it. Streak tracking, per-service schedules, collapsible sidebar cards. The Doubao service can also read its login cookies from the local Chrome, Edge, Brave or Doubao app cookie store (Doubao hosts only), and a custom service sends requests to whatever http(s) URL its JSON names.
description.zh: 每天自动给 MiniMax Code、WPS 灵犀、百度 DuMate、AStudio、Qoder、Trae、豆包、华为 CodeArts、腾讯 WorkBuddy 签到领积分：凭据取自本机 App 自己的登录态，不用手抠，每个服务支持多账号，列表之外的站点也能自己加——让 agent 查好接口、导入一份 JSON 就多一张卡片。带连续天数记账、按服务设时间、可折叠的侧边栏卡片。豆包服务还可以从本机 Chrome、Edge、Brave 或豆包 App 的 Cookie 库读取登录 Cookie（只取豆包的域名）；自定义服务会向其 JSON 里写的任意 http(s) 地址发请求。

description.en: Ten Markdown-reader colour schemes for DeepSeek Harness that repaint the window background and the rendered Markdown typography, with a dedicated settings page to switch between them.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供十种来自 Markdown 阅读器的阅读配色：整个窗口背景与正文排版跟随方案变化，并提供独立设置页切换。

description.en: Replaces LLM summarization with deterministic text compilation, so compaction makes no model calls and keeps original tokens; elided content stays retrievable through seq pointers. Based on TsFreddie/dsh-compaction-instant.
description.zh: 用确定性文本编译取代 LLM 摘要，压缩过程不调模型、只搬运原文，被省略的内容可凭 seq 指针取回。基于 TsFreddie/dsh-compaction-instant。

description.en: Self-contained DSH profile plugin that bridges the cua-driver 0.46.1 Windows kit into DSH as about 63 cua_* background desktop and browser automation tools (UIA observation, PostMessage input without focus stealing, CDP browser control, agent-cursor overlay, recording and diagnostics), with a bundled /cua-driver skill. Windows x64 only; bundles the prebuilt cua-driver.exe and starts it with --grant existing-profile, so the tools can attach to your already-running Edge or Chrome profile and act in its logged-in sessions.
description.zh: 自包含的 DSH profile 插件：把 cua-driver 0.46.1（Windows x86_64）驱动套件桥接进 DSH，提供约 63 个 cua_* 后台桌面与浏览器自动化工具（UIA 观察、不抢焦点的 PostMessage 输入、CDP 浏览器控制、代理光标叠加层、录制与诊断），并内置 /cua-driver skill。仅限 Windows x64；随包带预编译的 cua-driver.exe，并以 --grant existing-profile 启动它，所以这些工具可以接入你正在运行的 Edge 或 Chrome 配置并在其已登录的会话里操作。

description.en: HTML deliverable workbench in the file preview: viewport presets (desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile, A4), click-to-annotate elements with a notes/QA panel that docks to any edge or floats and sends the notes to the agent as one message, delivery QA grouped by category (figure/table numbering, orphans, clipping, overflow, page whitespace, WCAG contrast, images, dead anchors, banned words), PDF export through a local Chromium-based browser, and export of a self-contained annotated HTML that reviewers open in a browser to reply; also provides the `deliver_qa` and `deliver_export_pdf` tools and a `/deliver` command.
description.zh: 文件预览里的 HTML 交付物工作台：桌面、笔记本、平板、手机、A4 视口预设；点选元素就地批注，批注与 QA 收在可停靠任一边或浮动的面板里，批注可整理成一条消息发给 Agent；交付 QA 按类别分组（图表编号与引用、孤字、截断、溢出、页面留白、WCAG 对比度、图片、页内死链、禁用字样）；用本机 Chromium 内核浏览器导出 PDF；可导出自包含的带批注 HTML，审阅者在浏览器里打开即可回答；另提供 `deliver_qa`、`deliver_export_pdf` 工具与 `/deliver` 命令。

description.en: Digital Earth: opens a 3D globe beside the chat where you can load city models or drone-scanned scenes, measure distances, take screenshots, and run flood or sunlight analysis — or just ask the AI to do it (3D Tiles / 3DGS).
description.zh: 数字地球：在对话旁边打开三维地球，加载城市模型或实景三维数据就能浏览；量距离、截图、做淹没和日照分析，也可以一句话让 AI 代劳（支持 3D Tiles / 3DGS）。

description.en: Paste a Douyin video link (easy to copy from the Douyin PC app) and the plugin downloads the video, transcribes the speech offline into timed Chinese text, and imports it into Obsidian as a Markdown note. Built for DeepSeek Harness and for beginners building a personal knowledge base. Needs Python 3.10+ with playwright (it drives Edge), PyAV, sherpa-onnx and numpy installed, plus a SenseVoice model placed under %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\douyin-kb\models.
description.zh: 一个简单的人工提供抖音链接（可通过抖音PC客户端获得），由本插件自动将视频内容转化文字记录，并自动导入到Obsidian中，适用于harness、个人知识库搭建初学者上手。需要安装 Python 3.10+ 以及 playwright（驱动 Edge）、PyAV、sherpa-onnx 和 numpy，并把 SenseVoice 模型放到 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\douyin-kb\models。

description.en: Windows screenshot and annotation plugin with configurable global hotkeys, always-on-top pinned images, and capture delivery to the current DSH chat draft; requires a compatible Python runtime. Ships a prebuilt Windows executable (native/DualCtrlSnip.exe) and a Python helper that polls only the state of the selected hotkeys.
description.zh: Windows 截图与标注插件，支持自定义全局快捷键、置顶贴图和添加到当前 DSH 聊天附件草稿；需要兼容的 Python 运行环境。随包带有预编译的 Windows 可执行文件（native/DualCtrlSnip.exe）和一个只轮询所选快捷键状态的 Python 辅助程序。

description.en: A macOS global hotkey that opens a small prompt bar from any app and sends what you type, with an optional screenshot or window text, to a new or the last session.
description.zh: macOS 全局热键，在任意应用里唤出一个小输入条，把输入内容连同可选的截图或窗口文字发到新会话或最近的会话。

description.en: Requirement to a detailed design doc another AI can build from: the model fills a plan, the plugin validates it and emits a SPEC plus task cards, then independent review and implementation evidence check the result. Needs Python 3.11 or newer; the spec-graph engine it calls is bundled in the package.
description.zh: 需求 → 另一 AI 能直接开工的详细设计文档：模型填 plan，插件校验后产出 SPEC 与任务卡，再由独立评审与实现证据复核。需要 Python 3.11 及以上；它调用的 spec-graph 引擎已随包附带。

description.en: InfluxDB 2.x client for DeepSeek Harness: six agent tools and a side panel run Flux queries, inspect schemas and buckets, manage connections, and write line protocol.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 InfluxDB 2.x 插件：6 个智能体工具加一个侧边面板，可执行 Flux 查询、查看 schema 与 bucket、管理连接、写入 line protocol。

description.en: Multi-machine job board for DSH: 12 board tools, 4 shell tools, a GUI panel, and a dispatcher that hands queued tasks to remote hosts through dsh-remote-agent. Single-machine use starts its own loopback board; multi-machine use needs the bundled Python board server (tools/board_server.py, started with GP_BOARD_TOKEN set, binding 0.0.0.0 by default) and dsh-remote-agent hosts. The sh_* tools only reach directories on the allowedRoots list.
description.zh: DSH 多机作业板：12 个作业板工具、4 个命令工具、一个图形面板，并经 dsh-remote-agent 把排队任务派给多台机器。单机使用时会自己在回环地址起一个板子；多机使用需要随包附带的 Python 作业板服务（tools/board_server.py，启动前设置 GP_BOARD_TOKEN，默认绑定 0.0.0.0）和 dsh-remote-agent 主机。sh_* 工具只能访问 allowedRoots 名单里的目录。

description.en: Manage iterative text annotation through DSH tools with rule versions, stale-result isolation, human review preservation and traceable exports; requires a separately installed Python backend.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 工具管理可迭代文本标注，绑定规则版本、隔离旧任务结果、保留人工审核并导出可追溯数据集；需另行安装 Python 后端。

description.en: Floating, draggable sensor dashboard for the Harness Web UI on Windows: GPU-Z GPU temperature, clock and dedicated VRAM on the left, CPU temperature/clock and system memory on the right.
description.zh: Windows 上 Harness 网页界面的浮动可拖动传感器面板：左侧显示 GPU-Z 的 GPU 温度、频率和专用显存，右侧显示 CPU 温度、频率和系统内存。

description.en: Luo Tianyi theme skin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a full-window wallpaper, a sidebar character cutout, the Luo Tianyi brand mark and a #66CCFF palette.
description.zh: 洛天依和雅音宫羽主题皮肤，天依蓝配色。

description.en: An Eisenhower-matrix to-do panel for the DSH sidebar: importance × urgency quadrants that fill the panel, inline quick-add with a hand-drawn due-date calendar, drag to reorder or move between quadrants, a draggable center handle for quadrant proportions, one-click switch to the completed view, and random encouragement toasts that tell praised on-time finishes apart from overdue ones. Minimal styling uses only DSH theme tokens; bilingual UI.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的艾森豪威尔矩阵待办面板：重要 × 紧急四象限自动撑满面板，象限内 就地新增并自带自绘截止日期日历，拖动可在象限内排序或跨象限移动，拖动中心 圆点调整四象限比例，一键切换到「已完成」，完成时按按期/逾期给出不同的随机 鼓励浮窗。极简风，只用 DSH 主题 token，界面中英双语。

description.en: LAN task delegation between DSH hosts on one network: the parent dispatches a task to a child host, the child works in its own session and workspace, results and files return to the parent's inbox, sensitive actions wait for the parent's approval, and a finished task can be continued with one follow-up inside the child's existing session. By default each host listens on all network interfaces (0.0.0.0) on its own port over plain HTTP, with UDP discovery; pairing uses a six-digit code with no attempt limit, and a paired parent starts with no grant.
description.zh: 局域网内的 DSH 多机任务委派：上级把任务派给子级主机，子级在自己的会话与工作区里执行，结果与文件回到上级收件箱，敏感动作等待上级审批，完成的任务还能在子级原会话里接着追问一轮。默认每台主机会在自己的端口上监听全部网卡（0.0.0.0），走明文 HTTP，并用 UDP 做发现；配对用六位数字码，没有尝试次数限制，配对后的上级默认没有任何授权。

description.en: A gray-tabby Maine Coon desktop pet for dsh-pet — 28 transparent VP9-alpha actions (960×540 at 24fps), a native three-stage sleep cycle (go to bed → sleep loop → wake), and 13 whisper stickers; the installer is incremental and never overwrites files you edited.
description.zh: 缅因猫桌宠——28 个透明动作（960×540 / 24fps / VP9-alpha），原生三段睡眠（去睡觉 → 睡觉 → 起床）与 13 张碎碎念表情；安装器增量更新，不覆盖你改过的素材与配置。

description.en: Shows the remaining MiniMax coding-plan quota (5-hour window and weekly window) below the chat composer, with the detail on click.
description.zh: 在对话输入框下方显示 MiniMax 编程套餐剩余额度（5 小时窗口与周窗口），点击可查看详情。

description.en: Runs sessions on your own Claude Code and Codex CLIs from the model picker, and lets a DSH agent hand background tasks to them and follow up. Permission prompts cannot be answered from DSH: Claude Code runs in acceptEdits mode by default, Codex in its workspace-write sandbox, and ACP permission requests are approved automatically by default.
description.zh: 在模型选择器里用你本机的 Claude Code 和 Codex CLI 跑会话，也让 DSH agent 把后台任务交给它们并继续追问。权限提示无法在 DSH 里回答：Claude Code 默认以 acceptEdits 模式运行，Codex 用 workspace-write 沙箱，ACP 的权限请求默认自动批准。

description.en: Shows which hosts each local app connects to, restores real domain names through the local Clash/mihomo controller, and records first/last-seen times to the second.
description.zh: 看清本机每个软件在连哪些 host：经本地 Clash/mihomo 还原真实域名，并给出精确到秒的首次/最近时间。

description.en: OpenDesign (AMR) quota readout: the Design Plan 5-hour and 7-day windows, wallet balance and days-to-exhaust in a composer pill, read over a local controlKey or a browser session. The local source reads the controlKey from ~/.amr/config.json; the browser source opens a temporary Chrome window, and after you log in collects the session cookie over CDP into DSH's credential store.
description.zh: OpenDesign（AMR）额度读数：输入框旁显示 Design Plan 的 5 小时与 7 天窗口、钱包余额与外推天数，走本机 controlKey 或浏览器会话两条通道。本机来源会读取 ~/.amr/config.json 里的 controlKey；浏览器来源会打开一个临时 Chrome 窗口，你登录后通过 CDP 收集会话 cookie 存进 DSH 的凭据库。

description.en: Reads EPUB, TXT, Markdown and HTML from the workspaces registered in dsh in a right-sidebar tab, restores the last reading position, and collapses the whole sidebar with Esc to return to the conversation. No runtime dependencies and no build step.
description.zh: 在右侧栏标签里读取 dsh 已注册工作区内的 EPUB、TXT、Markdown 与 HTML，记住上次阅读位置，并可用 Esc 一键收起整个右侧栏回到会话。零运行时依赖、无需构建。

description.en: Mobile gateway plugin that pairs DSH Mobile App with a self-hosted DeepSeek Harness host over an authenticated WebSocket. Fork of Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway (same package name, install only one) that adds an optional encrypted address book deployed to your own Cloudflare account as a Worker with wrangler, an experimental WebRTC P2P transport, and a public-DoH fallback for its endpoint check.
description.zh: 让 DSH Mobile App 通过认证的 WebSocket 与自托管 DeepSeek Harness 宿主配对的手机网关插件。Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway 的分支（包名相同，只能装其中一个），新增可选的加密地址簿（用 wrangler 部署成你自己 Cloudflare 账号下的 Worker）、实验性的 WebRTC P2P 传输，以及端点检查时回退到公共 DoH。

description.en: Offline voice input for the composer: records with the microphone, transcribes locally with SenseVoice, and sends the message automatically. A derivative of the official voice-input plugin that adds auto-submit; first use downloads the SenseVoice model (about 242 MB) to ~/.dsh/speech-to-text/sensevoice, and it registers the same speech provider rows as the built-in Voice Input, so disable that one first.
description.zh: 输入框离线语音输入：麦克风录音后用 SenseVoice 在本机转写，转写完成即自动发送消息。是官方语音输入插件的衍生版，加入了自动发送；首次使用会把 SenseVoice 模型（约 242 MB）下载到 ~/.dsh/speech-to-text/sensevoice，并注册与内置语音输入相同的语音服务条目，请先停用内置的语音输入。

description.en: Quest tree for DeepSeek Harness: track a long-running task as a main quest plus a branch tree, with a sidebar panel showing status, progress, markdown notes and a 'you are here' marker to prevent drift.
description.zh: 任务树：把长任务维护成一条主线加分支树，侧边栏展示状态、进度、markdown 备注与「你在这」标记，防止跑偏。

description.en: Drives another DSH plugin's real interface from a script and records the real window to an animated GIF. Windows only. Its /recorder routes have no DSH access check, and the run route can make the open DSH page click and type, so any web page you have open could drive it; recordings capture a region of your screen with Pillow.
description.zh: 按脚本操作另一个 DSH 插件的真实界面，并把真实窗口录成 GIF。仅限 Windows。它的 /recorder 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，而 run 路由可以让已打开的 DSH 页面点击和输入，所以你打开的任何网页都可能驱动它；录制会用 Pillow 截取屏幕的一块区域。

description.en: Windows toast when a turn finishes, with one setting in Settings → General: Never, Only when unfocused, or Always.
description.zh: 回合结束时弹出 Windows 通知；在 设置 → 通用设置 里可选 从不 / 仅窗口不在前台时 / 始终。

description.en: Lets the agent read the app, title, URL and text of the window in front through the macOS Accessibility API, with opt-in on-device screen memory it can search.
description.zh: 让 agent 通过 macOS 辅助功能 API 读取最前窗口的应用、标题、URL 和文字，并可选开启本机屏幕记忆供其检索。

description.en: Learn from Bilibili videos, web pages, local files and live streams: local ASR, on-screen OCR and extractive digests add up to about 1.5KB of text per source, so the model reads a summary instead of a full transcript.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频、网页、本地文件和直播变成可检索的学习库：本地转写、画面 OCR、抽取式摘要，每个来源交回约 1.5KB 文本，让模型读摘要而不是全文。

description.en: Adds a recap card under the composer for the current session: turns, steps, tool calls grouped by name, the uncached / cache-read / cache-write / output token split, the cache-hit rate, and a cost range computed from the official Flash off-peak and peak list prices. Exports the same card as Markdown or a standalone HTML page.
description.zh: 在输入框下方为当前会话生成复盘卡：轮次、步数、按名称聚合的工具调用、未缓存 / 缓存读 / 缓存写 / 输出四段 Token、缓存命中率，以及按官网 Flash 峰谷挂牌价折算的花费区间；同一张卡可导出为 Markdown 或独立 HTML。

description.en: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness: move cold sessions out of the sidebar into a recoverable trash, restore them within the retention window (30 days by default), or delete their logs permanently. A trashed subagent tree moves and restores as a whole, a shared DSH toast offers undo, and the settings page supports search, sorting, multi-select batch restore and emptying the whole trash.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话回收站：把冷会话从侧边栏移入可恢复的回收站，保留期（默认 30 天）内可恢复，也可以永久删除日志。含隐藏 subagent 子会话的条目按整树移入、整树恢复；移入后 DSH 共享 Toast 提供撤销；设置页支持搜索、排序、勾选批量恢复与清空回收站。

description.en: Makes the DeepSeek Harness settings window resizable and configurable in size, with presets, drag resizing, and sizes saved to the profile config.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 设置窗口可配置大小并可拖动缩放，提供尺寸预设，并把尺寸保存到 profile 配置。

description.en: Model-facing skill_manage tool that saves, replaces, or deletes Harness skills at user or project scope, with a standing system-prompt section that asks the model to evaluate skill retention before ending a reusable task.
description.zh: 模型侧的 skill_manage 工具，可在用户级或项目级保存、替换、删除 Harness 技能，并常驻一段系统提示督促模型在收尾时评估技能沉淀。

description.en: Load skills to reveal bound tools on demand, with per-tool blocking and MCP support.
description.zh: 加载技能后按需解锁绑定工具，支持按工具拦截和 MCP 工具。

description.en: Security guard for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis): reviews every tool call in pre-execute against SlowMist agent-security rules, denying or flagging risky commands, MCP servers and skill loads, external URLs and repositories, untrusted documents, and EVM or Solana addresses; scans tool results for prompt injection after execution and ships a slowmist_scan audit tool plus an injected security policy prompt. Rules follow the open-source SlowMist Agent Security Skill (MIT).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (Cordis) 安全防护插件：在 pre-execute 阶段按慢雾 Agent Security 规则审查每一次工具调用，对高危命令、MCP 服务器与技能加载、外部 URL 与代码仓库、不可信文档、EVM 或 Solana 链上地址给出拒绝或警告；执行后对工具结果做提示注入扫描，内置 slowmist_scan 审计工具并注入安全策略提示词。规则遵循慢雾开源的 Agent Security Skill（MIT）。

description.en: Synchronizes native DSH instructions, user Skills, and reviewed portable settings across devices through Microsoft OneDrive, with optional cloud encryption and explicit conflict resolution; conversations and credentials are excluded.
description.zh: 通过 Microsoft OneDrive 跨设备同步 DSH 原生指令、用户 Skills 和经过审核的可迁移设置，支持可选云端加密与明确的冲突处理；不同步会话和凭据。

description.en: Per-teammate model selection for Agent Teams - a chip in the teammate's own composer pins one model for that member, or the member follows the lead conversation's current model on every step; pins survive restarts. Pins are saved in $DSH_HOME/plugin-data/team-member-model.json, and its /plugin/team-member-model routes (model catalog, setting a teammate's model) have no access check.
description.zh: 为 Agent Teams 的子队友单独指定模型——在成员会话输入框的胶囊里固定一个模型，或让成员每一步跟随主对话当前使用的模型；指定重启后仍生效。指定结果存在 $DSH_HOME/plugin-data/team-member-model.json；/plugin/team-member-model 路由（模型目录、给成员换模型）没有访问校验。

description.en: Team presets for AgentTeams: ships audit6 / impl5 / lite2 rosters with seed task DAGs and a per-role report contract, plus a captain doctrine section, so a fresh session opens the right team in one approval instead of a pasted prompt. Needs the engine @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams added to the same profile first; the team patch targets that engine's entry by id and replaces its whole agent-teams config.
description.zh: AgentTeams 的团队预置：内置 audit6 / impl5 / lite2 三套编制与 seed 任务 DAG（每个角色带回报合同），并注入一段 captain 开团纪律——新会话一次批准就开出结构正确的团队，不用再贴提示词。需要先把引擎 @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams 装进同一个 profile；团队补丁按 id 指向该引擎，并会整段替换其 agent-teams 配置。

description.en: Desert-dusk theme for the Harness Web GUI: paints a desert scene behind the app with four flocks of geese flying south over the long river at sunset, and overrides 18 --dsw-alias design tokens with a matching warm palette.
description.zh: 大漠黄昏主题：在 Harness Web GUI 背后铺一层大漠场景——落日沉入长河、四群归雁向南飞去，并覆盖 18 个 --dsw-alias 设计变量，换成配套的暖沙色板。

description.en: Moves reasoning that a provider leaks into the visible text channel back into the reasoning channel, and emits a text block when a whole turn of answer text lands only in the reasoning channel. Catches three shapes: `<thinking>`-tagged text, text that continues a reasoning tail which ended mid-token, and an answer-only reasoning turn that stops. Healthy streams pass through unchanged, block order is preserved, and each of the four rules can be switched off in one JSON config.
description.zh: 把供应商漏进可见正文通道的思考搬回思考通道；若整轮回答只落在思考通道，则补发一个正文块。覆盖三种形态：带 `<thinking>` 标记的正文、接在悬空思维尾部继续写的正文、以及以 stop 收尾却只有思考的回答。健康流量原样透传、块顺序不变，四条规则可在同一个 JSON 配置里逐条关闭。

description.en: Adds 17 barotrauma_* tools to DeepSeek Harness for making Barotrauma mods: environment probing, mod skeleton, item and weapon XML, afflictions, creatures, random events, Lua and C# script scaffolding, localization, validation, icon generation, zip packaging and Steam Workshop publish notes. barotrauma_gen_icon sends your prompt to image.pollinations.ai and writes the returned image into the mod folder; on Windows the Steam install path is read with reg query.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 17 个 barotrauma_* 工具，用于制作潜渊症 mod：环境探测、内容包骨架、物品/武器/状态效果/角色/随机事件 XML、Lua 与 C# 脚本脚手架、本地化、校验、图标生成、打包与创意工坊发布文案。barotrauma_gen_icon 会把你的提示词发到 image.pollinations.ai，并把返回的图写进 mod 目录；在 Windows 上会用 reg query 读取 Steam 安装路径。

description.en: Stops session lockups from OpenAI-compatible gateways that stream empty tool-call ids: intercepts llm/stream chunks in memory to synthesize consistent call_<sha256> ids across tool-call-delta and block-end, plus offline session repair/verify scripts under tools/.
description.zh: 修复并预防 OpenAI 兼容网关流式返回空 tool_call id 导致的 DSH v4 会话锁死：在 llm/stream 拦截点纯内存合成一致的 call_<sha256> ID 补全 tool-call-delta 与 block-end，并在仓库 tools/ 下附带离线会话修复与校验脚本。

description.en: Adds an independent code font-size axis and per-plugin font-size sliders to the DSH font settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 字体设置面板增加代码字号独立轴，并为每个插件提供单独的字号滑杆。

description.en: Keeps code edits in a review loop instead of letting the model edit files: each change is proposed as a two-column diff card with line numbers, applied by hand or with one click, and handed back for verification with another click.
description.zh: 把代码修改放进评审回路，而不是让模型直接改文件：每处改动以带行号的两列 diff 卡片提出，用户手动落地或一键应用，再点一下把接力棒交回给 AI 复核。

description.en: Rewrites a draft prompt against the current project: a composer button, slash command and agent tool ground the rewrite in the workspace stack, structure and conventions.
description.zh: 结合当前项目重写提示词：通过输入框按钮、斜杠命令或 Agent 工具，依据工作区的技术栈、结构与约定改写草稿。

description.en: Ren'Py localization toolkit that generates a full translation skeleton from compiled games, ports existing translations, and validates them.
description.zh: Ren'Py 汉化工具集：为只有 .rpyc 的成品游戏生成完整翻译骨架，移植旧译本并校验译文。

description.en: Reviews each finished turn, distills reusable skills as drafts, runs code-level checks over them, and holds each draft until the user approves or rejects it with a directive; every write is recorded in a SHA-256 ledger that supports rolling back a single entry. On by default, it reviews finished turns with the current session model (or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint set through DSH_EVOLUTION_BASE_URL), sending a bounded excerpt of the conversation, and writes drafts to ~/.dsh/skills/.staging until you promote them. Its bundle patch lowers DSH's skill-catalog description limit from 500 to 80 characters for every skill, and it starts an unauthenticated HTTP server on 0.0.0.0:18890 (DSH_EVOLUTION_PORT) that can list and promote drafts, change settings and trigger reviews.
description.zh: 回合结束后复盘会话，把经验蒸馏成技能草稿，经代码级检查后等你批示采纳或驳回；每次落盘都记入 SHA-256 账本，支持按单条回滚。默认开启，回合结束后用当前会话模型（或 DSH_EVOLUTION_BASE_URL 指定的 OpenAI 兼容接口）复盘一段有上限的会话摘录，草稿写在 ~/.dsh/skills/.staging，等你采纳才进正式技能库。随包补丁会把 DSH 全局技能目录的描述上限从 500 收紧到 80 字符（影响所有技能）；另外它在 0.0.0.0:18890（可用 DSH_EVOLUTION_PORT 改）启动一个没有鉴权的 HTTP 服务，可列出和采纳草稿、改设置、触发复盘。

description.en: 基于dsh的rp卡自动编写插件，当前支持风月（fengyue.ai）平台
description.zh: 把一句话想法自动做成能直接导入平台开玩的 RP 卡，支持风月平台，分步人工验证。

description.en: Meshy 3D generation and 3D printing skills driving meshy-cli through the shell: text-to-3D and image-to-3D, texturing, remeshing, rigging and animation, format conversion, and print-ready 3MF/STL with printability repair and slicer handoff. Bundles the CLI and keeps the sign-in on the host side, with a Meshy sidebar page, a Settings → Meshy page and an interactive GLB preview in Web and Desktop; installable as `meshy-dsh`. Needs a Meshy account; generation spends Meshy credits after you confirm the cost.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 meshy-cli 的 Meshy 3D 生成与 3D 打印 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、贴图、重拓扑、绑骨与动画、格式转换，以及带可打印检查与修复的 3MF/STL 打印文件和切片软件交接。插件自带 CLI 并在宿主侧保持登录，在 Web 和 Desktop 中提供 Meshy 侧边栏页面、设置 → Meshy 页面和可交互的 GLB 预览；npm 包名 `meshy-dsh`。需要 Meshy 账号；生成会消耗 Meshy 点数，花费前先让你确认。

description.en: 在启动时清理空闲的DSH会话日志（不是上下文压缩）。Trim idle DSH session logs at startup (not context compaction).
description.zh: 启动时自动裁掉空闲会话日志里模型早已看不到的旧窗口，先过三层校验再落盘，日志不再只增不减。

description.en: Public/synthetic eval-pack lint and deterministic JSON grader; not a validated benchmark.
description.zh: 给公开或合成的评测集做格式检查，并用确定性 JSON 评分器打分，方便快速验证评测包。

description.en: [FROZEN 2026-10-31] Electricity activity ingest, location-based GHG calculation, row verification, workpaper and partial ESRS pack.
description.zh: 把用电活动数据导入后按位置算温室气体排放，还能逐行核验、生成工作底稿和部分 ESRS 报告包。

description.en: Read-only install doctor: capability snapshot, tarball assert and install diagnosis.  Install-only companion to dsh-plugin-doctor (tarball/install-log diagnosis).
description.zh: 只读安装体检工具，快照能力、校验压缩包并诊断安装问题，专治装不上、装不对。

description.en: Mermaid diagrams for DeepSeek Harness — on-demand rendering, compact ELK layout by default, theme-aware, copy and fullscreen zoom viewer
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里按需渲染 Mermaid 图表，默认紧凑 ELK 布局，支持主题适配、复制和全屏缩放查看。

description.en: General Agentics distribution bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one install brings white-label brand, curated plugins, bundled skills, and MCP pre-configuration. Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), MIT licensed.
description.zh: 装一次就给 DSH 换上自定义品牌外观，还自带技能和 MCP 预配置，开箱即用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: your DeepSeek API balance and the current peak/off-peak billing window, below the message input.
description.zh: 在消息输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额和当前计费时段，帮你随时掌握用量和花费。
